title: Digital High Risk Work Licence – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for using a Digital High Risk Work Licence (DHRWL) issued by Service NSW.
who_can_apply: Have or are able to obtain a MyServiceNSW Account
Hold a valid high risk work licence
Have or will link your MyServiceNSW Account to your high risk work licence
what_you_need: A valid high risk work licence

faqs.q: Is the Digital High Risk Work Licence (DHRWL) mandatory?
faqs.a: No, a DHRWL is optional. It will only be issued in addition to the physical form of a high risk work licence.

faqs.q: What should I carry when working outside of NSW?
faqs.a: You should always carry your physical high risk work licence, as the DHRWL may not be recognised in other states and territories.

faqs.q: What are my responsibilities regarding the DHRWL device?
faqs.a: You must ensure the device holding your DHRWL is working, charged, and that the screen can be inspected without obstruction or damage.
